Subject: Prominent display of the extract of Form 5A at the entrance of the establishment
or on the website along with mobile application of the establishment— regarding.

Madam/Sir,

In exercise of power conferred under section 78(1) of the Employees’ Provident Funds
Scheme, 1952, the Central Government has directed Employees Provident Fund Organisation to
issue order to ensure prominent display of the extract of Form 5A at the entrance of the
establishment or on their website along with mobile application.

2. Accordingly, the Central P.F. Commissioner, in exercise of powers conferred under Para
78(3) of the Employees’ Provident Funds Scheme 1952, has issued directions for display of the
extract of the Form SA at the entrance of the establishment or on their website along with mobile
application. A copy of the order is attached as Annexure-A.

3. You are requested to bring it to the notice of the employers of the establishments covered
under your jurisdiction.

[Issued with the approval of the CPFC]

ORDER

In the matter of : Issue of direction under Para 78(3) of the Employees’ Provident
Funds Scheme, 1952 for proper implementation of the Scheme.

In pursuance of the directions issued by the Central Government (the Ministry of
Labour & Employment, Govt. of India) under Para 78(1) of the Employees’ Provident
Funds Scheme, 1952, I, Ramesh Krishnamurthi, Central Provident Fund Commissioner,
hereby issue the following directive in exercise of powers conferred under Para 78(3) of
the said Scheme :

Employers of establishments covered under the Act are directed to ensure
prominent display of the extract of Form SA at the entrance of the establishment OR on
the website along with mobile application of the establishment.

i. <EPF Code>

2. Employers of the establishments are requested to ensure compliance to above
noted directions within 15 days of issue of this order.

legal action under Employees’ Provident Funds & Miscellaneous Provision Act, 1952
and the Schemes framed thereunder.
